$comment: Component categories (FT Visual Vocabulary + investment-banking specific). Order = display order.

categories.name: Layout & narrative
categories.desc: Cover, headline numbers, key takeaways and text that frame the story.
categories.desc_zh: 封面、关键数字、核心结论与文字说明，搭建报告的叙事骨架。

categories.name: Controls & query
categories.desc: Global filters, scenario switches, what-if parameters and the client query console.
categories.desc_zh: 全局筛选、情景切换、参数假设（what-if）与客户自助查询控制台。

categories.name: Valuation
categories.desc: Football fields and other valuation summaries.
categories.desc_zh: 估值足球场图等估值总结类图表。

categories.name: Change over time
categories.desc: Share price, financials and multiples over time.
categories.desc_zh: 股价、财务指标、估值倍数随时间的变化。

categories.name: Magnitude & ranking
categories.desc: Compare sizes and ranks across peers, segments or periods.
categories.desc_zh: 比较同业、业务板块或不同期间的规模与排名。

categories.name: Bridges & deviation
categories.desc: Walk from one number to another; variance versus a reference.
categories.desc_zh: 从一个数字走到另一个数字（如 EBITDA 桥），以及相对基准的偏差。

categories.name: Part-to-whole
categories.desc: Mix, share and hierarchy: donut, treemap, sunburst, Marimekko.
categories.desc_zh: 结构、份额与层级：环形图、矩形树图、旭日图、马赛克图。

categories.name: Distribution & correlation
categories.desc: Scatter, bubble, heatmap, box plot — relationships between metrics and their spread.
categories.desc_zh: 散点、气泡、热力矩阵、箱线图——指标间的关系与分布。

categories.name: Flow & relationships
categories.desc: Sankey, chord, networks, entity structures and funnels.
categories.desc_zh: 桑基图、弦图、关系网络、股权/法人结构图与漏斗图。

categories.name: Geospatial
categories.desc: Offline maps: choropleth, proportional symbols, flows, clusters, density.
categories.desc_zh: 离线地图：分级着色、比例符号（气泡）、流向弧线、聚合点与密度热力。

categories.name: Tables
categories.desc: Comps, sensitivity, pivot and interactive data grids.
categories.desc_zh: 可比公司表、敏感性分析表、透视表与交互式数据表格。

categories.name: Process & timeline
categories.desc: Deal timetables, Gantt charts and milestones.
categories.desc_zh: 交易时间表、甘特图与里程碑。
